assessment_scope.source_boundary: Only the subject's single curated REVIEWED item at basis_commit, read in full with its front matter: the active_provisional V2 Kaori monograph series/sound-euphonium/04 Character Modeling/HIBIKE_KAORI_CHARACTER_MONOGRAPH.md (v0.1, source_backtested_pre_independent_audit), repository literary analysis of the locked Japanese prose core HIBIKE-V01 through HIBIKE-V14 with Kaori evidence located in V01-V04, V07, V09, V10, V12 and V13. The sequential readings, ledgers, Asuka model and audits it names as inputs are not curated on this subject; locators cited below are the monograph's own citations, and no claim rests on unread linked material. The project's labels (tier B, provisional_partial simulation readiness) are not adopted. The governing method and corpus map were consulted for context only; the corpus map at basis still describes the Kaori monograph as not yet created. No primary-source inspection was performed.
assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: Kaori from the V13 S02 pre-mainline retrospective (early Kitauji, Natsuki exchange) through the V01 solo year, the V03 Asuka crisis, the V04 low-brass envy scene, the V10 S03 Kaori-focal graduation retrospective and letter, postgraduate V07 and V09 appearances, and V12 S04 cohabitation and adult advice as the latest dramatized state, with the V13 S04 nursing-school fact and Yuuko's view of postgraduate Kaori as retrospective biography. Capability states split at located changes: before and after the V01 S05 second audition (P0653-P0695); within V10 S03 her stated love precedes the destabilizing 'ordinary Asuka' question (P0098-P0104), which she cannot answer; her tolerance of asymmetric specialness is first stated in V12 S04 (P0577-P0590) and is not available at V10. Events between V10 and V12 and after V13 are outside the evidence.
assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit, applying the owner calibration rulings recorded there (B/C boundary, single counting of uncertainty, dialogue constrained-use test, chronology splits, relationship-transfer safeguards and control-state attribution); evidence-located calibration with countercases, explicit gaps and no model-readiness inheritance.

dimensions.note: The monograph gives a discriminating decision policy, notice value -> preserve participation -> assess reality -> pursue a legitimate avenue -> seek recognition -> accept the other's authorship, and says what changes it: personal stake raises persistence and directness (V01 re-audition request P0653-P0664; V10 love and cohabitation proposal P0076-P0116), relationship decides whether she restrains (Yuuko, V01 S05 P0236-P0270) or presses (Asuka, V01 S05 P0353-P0381), and accurate status perception removes motivated blindness as a defense (V01 S04 P0378-P0387). It separates relationship-specific insecurity from generally high self-worth with Kaori-owned focalization (V10 S03 P0093-P0095) and predicts overreach: physical insistence against Asuka's boundary (V03 S03 P0036-P0039) and pressing for a judgment she already knows. Not A: one unaudited monograph, few independent clusters and the stress tests are model output. Not C: the account explains why her response differs by stake, relationship, channel and state and states where it stops (family, nursing, institutional command); the open V01 nattoku mechanism is triangulated [C] and narrows confidence rather than leaving competing motives undecided.

Six named states with boundaries and state rules (EARLY_KITAUJI, V01_SOLO, V03_ASUKA_CRISIS, V10_GRADUATION_RETROSPECTIVE, POSTGRAD_V07_V09, POSTGRAD_V12) and a developmental axis toward self-authored attachment, with the V10 'ordinary Asuka' question and the V12 asymmetric-specialness theory located. Not B: the V10-to-V12 change happens off the page and the monograph names the shift without a causal account; V02, V05-V06, V08 and V11 are nearly empty for her, so states are snapshots rather than a sequenced trajectory. Not D: state rules are explicit and located.

Baseline tendencies (私, gentle endings, softeners, fufu laughter, Standard and Kansai-compatible forms), the rule that soft surface does not imply weak propositional content (V10 S03 P0076-P0085), a separate written channel (graduation letter P0109-P0116), an adult advice register (V12 S04 P0563-P0665) and a list of voice negatives. Not B: the monograph quotes almost no Japanese, gives tendencies rather than addressee-conditioned rules, and has had no realization audit, unlike the project's audited models. Not D: register shifts by stake, channel and age are analyzed with anchors.

V12 domestic care is practical and mildly supervisory (groceries, tea, correcting Asuka's laziness, P0591-P0628) with an explicit limit that it is not a mothering role; V07 ordinary teasing, embarrassment and mild jealousy (S01 P0393-P0462); V04 unintended envy of low-brass ease (S02 P0185-P0195); visible blushing (V01 S03 P0514-P0525). Not B: ordinary life is sampled in a few scenes, almost all with Asuka. Not D: the sampled behavior carries a stated conditional account (relationship-conditioned touch and regulation).

The relationship matrix gives a Kaori-side mechanism and asymmetry for Asuka, Yuuko, Reina, Kumiko and Natsuki, and the behavior differs as predicted: she restrains and apologizes for Yuuko's escalation, presses and touches Asuka, concedes to and later comforts Reina (V03 S04 P1378-P1382), de-centers her own view with Natsuki (V13 S02 P0533) and gives Kumiko bounded experience plus a two-part action (V12 S04 P0629-P0633). The Asuka dyad is further split by state (V03 pursuit versus V12 correction). Not A: Haruka, family and the wider peer network are thin and the Asuka-side category stays open. Not C: the deltas are directional and explained by stake and the other person's position, not only listed.

Direct Kaori focalization is confined to V10 S03 (worry about future juniors, knowing she is loved, the destabilizing question); elsewhere her inner states come through Asuka's, Natsuki's, Yuuko's or Kumiko's perception, which the monograph tags [B]/[C] and keeps apart from Kaori-owned evidence. Not B: one focal section cannot carry a broad inner model, and the V01 motive is not given in her own terms (O-01). Not D: the focal section is rich and ownership is carefully separated.

A conditional conflict policy: low-force boundary setting in public (stopping Yuuko, V01 S05 P0236-P0270), private emotionally direct persistence within a close relationship (pressing Asuka, P0353-P0381), physical insistence under attachment threat that stops at Asuka's boundary (V03 S03 P0036-P0039; S04 P0093-P0117), and adult interpretive repair (V12 S04 P0563-P0566, P0605-P0633). The monograph names which condition moves her between these. Not A: institutional conflict, peer conflict outside the named dyads and the illegitimate-procedure case (K-S03) are extrapolations it rates moderate. Not C: the escalation conditions and their limit are located across four volumes.

Located positions: hard work should be rewarded (V13 S02 P0540-P0544), concession after a fair comparison (V01 S05 P0681-P0695), concern for future juniors (V10 S03 P0052-P0067) and the V12 view that individually not-wrong people can produce a bad collective outcome (P0563-P0566). Not B: the monograph shows positions and one decisive act more than deliberation, and the case where fairness and attachment conflict, or procedure is illegitimate, is unsourced extrapolation. Not D: the fairness-in-relation account is explicit and consistent across states.

Fufu laughter, gentle teasing, frustrated play-hitting of Asuka (V01 S05) and V12 reciprocal teasing are noted, and the monograph rates ordinary humor moderate. Not C: no account of what she finds funny or how play changes with audience. Not E: the cues recur across V01, V07 and V12.

The monograph declares its source lock and Kaori's evidence clusters, carries a 27-row evidence matrix with paragraph locators, corrects a stale V08 locator to V09, and maps density by domain including low and underdetermined domains. Not B: it is a single active-provisional artifact without its planned independent audit, whether the cluster list is exhaustive is unverified, and the project entrypoint at basis has not registered it. Not D: coverage is explicit and located.

KC-01 to KC-12 each pair a tempting misreading with located canon that contradicts it (politeness is not indirectness, V10; yielding is not merit denial, V01; restraint of Yuuko against endorsing her cause; no generic low self-esteem, V10 P0093-P0095; V12 serenity is not closure, P0584), and the musical negatives rest on her own recognition that Reina is better (V01 S04 P0378-P0387). Not A: the hard falsifiers are untested. Not C: the constraints are affirmative and located, not gaps restated as limits.

Claims carry volume, section and paragraph locators and are routed to named states, the V13 S02 retrospective is placed before V01, the V09 ring scene is relocated from V08, and the monograph forbids resolving the V10 conditionality question retroactively from V12 (O-02). Not A: the off-page V10-V12 interval and post-V13 life are unlocated. Not C: state assignment is explicit for nearly every claim.

conditions: Illustrative reconstruction of a named state, never attributed quotation; canon Japanese is retrieved from the source, which this evidence does not quote.

Registers limited to the sampled ones: gentle de-escalation and apology (V01 S05), soft but insistent questioning of Asuka (V01 S05), explicit attachment speech (V10 S03), the written letter channel (V10 S03), and adult confidential reflection, correction and advice (V12 S04).

Keep the monograph's voice negatives: no constant saccharine politeness or Kansai caricature, no Yuuko temperature, Asuka theater or Reina clipped absolutism, and no therapy vocabulary about herself; written earnestness is not her spoken baseline.
scenario_readiness.note: The register tendencies, channel distinction and negatives constrain output enough for illustrative use in the sampled registers. Not READY: no Japanese realization audit and few quoted lines. Not NOT_READY: the stake, channel and age conditions on register are evidenced.

conditions: Change one variable at a time from a named state along the monograph's perturbation axes (stake, competitor strength, public or private, Yuuko present, Asuka high-school or adult, procedure legitimate or not, written or live, advising or being the object of the decision) and state it; the output must differ across them.

A legitimately lost role to a stronger player, a junior considering quitting, Yuuko escalating on her behalf and an adult junior asking advice are sampled; an illegitimate procedure (K-S03) and a high-stakes commitment request to someone other than Asuka are separate, lower-confidence extrapolations.
A transfer to a comparable junior outside Natsuki, Reina and Kumiko is a separate lower-confidence condition justified only by the de-centering pattern.

cross_scenario_scope.assumed_chronology: One named state: early Kitauji, V01 before or after the second audition, V03 crisis, V10 S03 before or after the 'ordinary Asuka' question, postgraduate V07-V09, or V12; V12's asymmetric-specialness theory is unavailable earlier.
cross_scenario_scope.interlocutor_relationship: Asuka as her closest attachment, Yuuko as devoted junior, Reina as stronger rival then cared-for junior, Kumiko as junior witness then advice recipient, or Natsuki as a discouraged junior.
setting_constraints: Kitauji brass band competition and club life, alumni visits, or postgraduate domestic and social settings.
No family, clinical nursing, workplace or cross-series settings without a stated assumption.

scenario_readiness.note: The decision policy, conditional conflict policy and relationship matrix support bounded counterfactuals; the stress tests are untested model output and set expectations, not evidence.

conditions: Low-stakes warm exchanges, teasing and embarrassment in club or alumni settings, and V12 domestic regulation with Asuka, at a named state.
Family scenes and peers outside the named relationships require abstention.
scenario_readiness.note: V07, V09 and V12 sample ordinary interaction with Asuka and the club. Not READY: the ordinary-life sample is narrow and Asuka-centered.

conditions: Fair-selection disputes in which she has a personal stake under a legitimate procedure, restraining partisan support on her behalf, and advice that returns a decision to its owner.
Conflicts between fairness and attachment, or an illegitimate procedure, are lower-confidence extrapolation.
scenario_readiness.note: Located positions and the V01 concession support narrow prediction; deliberation itself is thinly shown.

conditions: Kaori's side of the Asuka attachment at a named state: pursuit under blocked access (V03), direct love, primacy and cohabitation with a no-force off-ramp (V10), mild jealousy and ring-coded continuity (V07, V09), and cohabiting tolerance of asymmetry (V12).
No formal relationship label, no sexual behavior and no answer to whether her V10 love depends on Asuka's specialness; Asuka's reciprocity category stays open.
scenario_readiness.note: Kaori-owned love language and located intimacy evidence support her side within these limits; the monograph keeps the formal category and V12 affect open.

The only professional fact is nursing-school attendance (V13 S04 P0064-P0066), which the monograph keeps as biography and marks unknown under professional stress (O-06). Club section and competition behavior are assessed under the other scenarios, not as professional work.

known_limits.statement: All claims rest on one active-provisional monograph that records itself as source-backtested before its planned independent audit and Asuka-Kaori reciprocal audit; its stress tests K-S01 to K-S08 are model output, not evidence.
Love language, rings, physical intimacy and cohabitation do not establish a formal Asuka-Kaori relationship category inside the locked source (O-04, KC-10).
Whether high-school Kaori's love depended on Asuka being special is left unanswered at V10 S03 P0098-P0104 and must not be resolved from V12 (O-02).
The narration cannot tell whether V12 Kaori is fully content with asymmetric specialness or performing it (P0584, O-03, KC-12).
She is a serious, improving player who recognizes Reina is better; do not model her as a virtuoso, technical diagnostician or pedagogical designer.
Her reformist concern appears as asking a capable person (Asuka, V10 S03 P0066-P0067) to change Kitauji, not as taking an institutional reformer role herself (O-05).
Direct Kaori interiority is confined to V10 S03; other inner states are inferred through other characters' perception.
No evidence covers her family, clinical or nursing-school behavior, or peers outside the named relationships, and the V10-V12 interval is off the page.
No Japanese realization audit or native-speaker check of generated Kaori dialogue exists in the evidence, and the monograph quotes little source Japanese.
